reason: An authentication utility for DeepSeek Harness that adds a Web UI login gate, CAPTCHA, credential and token verification endpoints, brute-force lockouts, session management, password-file administration, and optional Nginx authentication integration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供登录门、图形验证码、会话管理、账号密码维护和登录失败限制。
summaries.en: Adds a login gate, CAPTCHA, session management, account and password administration, and failed-login throttling to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

capabilities: Provides CAPTCHA, login, token verification, logout, and account-management HTTP endpoints
Manages in-memory sessions, account and IP lockouts, and optional IP-bound tokens
Reads and writes bcrypt-based password files and persisted security settings
Registers a Web UI login gate and security settings interface
Supports optional Nginx auth_request integration for request authentication
